A dedicated visual pass beyond the UX audit: colour, type, spacing, components, logo, iconography,
imagery, motion — aligned with [BRANDING.md](../../docs/BRANDING.md).

Distinct from the UX pass on purpose. UX asks whether someone can answer their question; this asks
whether the answer looks like it comes from a product worth trusting. For a nightlife site those are
not the same question, and the second one is doing more work than it usually does.
